name: B10-0241/2026 (S&D) – Implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text:
The European Parliament says the EU's rules on cleaning urban wastewater must be fully applied, including a newer, more thorough treatment step that removes medicine and cosmetics residues. It wants the companies that make these products to pay most of the cost of that treatment, not taxpayers or water bill payers. It asks for careful watching of medicine prices and supply, especially for cheaper generic medicines, and rejects any delay to these payment rules.

- What changes: no law changes; Parliament backs the existing wastewater rules and their payment system.
- Who it affects: pharmaceutical and cosmetics companies, water utilities, national governments, patients.
- What happens next: EU countries design payment schemes; the Commission reviews the rules by 2033 and 2040.
